CORRECTED 2026-09 (batch11 discovery): this model's 23-gene coefficient table is byte-identical (to 15 decimal places) to PMC10900655's colorectal-cancer 'LRGS' lactylation signature (published 2024 in J Transl Med, two years before this paper's 2026 publication). Near-certain evidence this is a reuse/relabeling of PMC10900655's model output under a different disease claim, not an independently-derived breast-cancer model. Removed from the 102-model quantitative set (its original BRCA attribution was never FDR-significant, so removal does not change the significant-model count); PMC10900655 (the earlier, presumed-original publication) is counted instead under its actually-claimed cancer type (colorectal, GSE81861) -- see MODEL_TO_DATASET in 15_cross_theme_meta_analysis.py and 31_pmc10900655_crc_attribution.py.
